newsitem.title: USA: TVA Sequoyah 1 nuke at 15 pct, increasing output.
newsitem.headline: TVA Sequoyah 1 nuke at 15 pct, increasing output.

text.p: TVA Nuclear's 1,148 megawatt (MW) Sequoyah 1 nuclear power plant, in Soddy-Daisy, Tenn., was at 15 percent of its production capacity after an outage over the weekend, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Monday.
The NRC daily status report said the unit was increasing its production, but gave no reason for the outage.
It had been at full power production Friday.
TVA Nuclear is a unit of the Tennessee Valley Authority, a federal agency that produces and markets electricity in the Tennessee region.
The TVA declines as a matter of policy to comment on the status of its plants' operations.
